# Live Fire Instruction - Concealed Carry Classes in Fairfax VA – Expert Firearms Training

> Live Fire Instruction is the premier firearms training academy based in [Fairfax, Virginia]. We are [NRA-Certified/State-Certified] instructors dedicated to providing safe, professional, and comprehensive firearm education for civilians, homeowners, and responsible citizens. Our mission is to build confident, knowledgeable shooters through hands-on live-fire exercises and expert classroom instruction.

Website: https://livefireinstruction.com/

## Core Training Services
- **First Steps Shooting Course & VA Concealed Carry Permit / Express Course (An NRA Program):** A fast three hour NRA pistol course for beginners include classroom, live range time & VA CCW
- **Basic Pistol Course & VA Concealed Carry Permit (An NRA Program):** An exciting 6-hour in-depth entry level pistol course with classroom, live range time & VA CCW
